question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>7</mn><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi mathvariant="italic">c</mi><mo mathvariant="italic">→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></math>. If a vector <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>d</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> satisfies <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>d</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>×</mo><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mover><mi>c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>×</mo><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>d</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>·</mo><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mn>24</mn><mo>,</mo></math> then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced open="|" close="|"><mover><mi>d</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></mfenced><mn>2</mn></msup></math> is equal to

solution.text:
We have been given that

d→×b→=c→×b→

⇒(d→-c→)×b→=0

⇒d→-c→=λb→  (∵d→≠c→)

⇒d→=c→+λb→

It is given that a→·d→=24 

⇒a→·c→+λb→·a→=24

⇒6+λ(3-8+14)=24

⇒9λ=18

⇒λ=2

∴d→=c→+2b→

⇒d→=8i^-5j^+18k^

|d→|2=64+25+324=413

Hence, this is the correct option.
